title: AC1021 TABLECONTENT CadValue object-ID role and retry
scope: Verify the TABLECONTENT CadValue type-64 Object ID handle role and parser reset/retry behavior with generated AC1021 vectors.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.field: CadValue type 64 (Object Id) is an H handle read from the handles section and is a soft pointer.

generatedControls: A hard-pointer encoding for a type-64 CadValue Object ID is rejected, the input is marked bad, and the parser resets its parse-complete flag and retained rows.
The same parser instance accepts the corrected soft-pointer encoding, retains object ID 0xA721 and TABLESTYLE handle 0xA700, reports complete semantic content, and consumes the bounded frame.
implementation.result: Build succeeded; 1 of 1 focused tests passed.

fixtureDisposition: Both vectors are authored in memory from scratch. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
outputBoundary: This closes only the generated AC1021 TABLECONTENT CadValue type-64 handle-role control. It does not establish producer-wire provenance, TABLE graph closure, strict output/readback, native rendering, or broader AC1021 support.
